title: Connect the starting point
learningGoal: Start a workflow when the correct form is submitted.

items.title: Open Sites → Forms
items.description: Review your enquiry form and confirm name and email fields are present.

items.title: Confirm Required Fields
items.description: Ensure the form captures the minimum information needed for follow-up.

items.title: Name It Clearly
items.description: Use a descriptive name like M17 | Consultation enquiry | Follow-up.

items.title: Add Form Submitted Trigger
items.description: Select the trigger Form Submitted, filter Form is, and choose only the intended enquiry form.

items.title: Save Unpublished
items.description: Keep the workflow unpublished until you have tested it thoroughly.

items.title: Prevent Wrong Triggers
items.description: Without the filter, the wrong form could start a sales follow-up, such as a customer service form or feedback survey.

items.title: Exercise for Consultants
items.description: Choose the form used for strategy enquiries and note its exact name.

keyPoint: Create a workflow with the Form Submitted trigger, filter by the exact enquiry form, and keep it unpublished until tested. The filter prevents unrelated forms from triggering your sales sequence.

actionSteps.title: Review your enquiry form
actionSteps.description: Open Sites → Forms and confirm your enquiry form has name and email fields.

actionSteps.title: Create a new workflow
actionSteps.description: Open Automation → Workflows and create a workflow named M17 | Consultation enquiry | Follow-up.

actionSteps.title: Add and filter the trigger
actionSteps.description: Add Form Submitted trigger, filter Form is, and select only your intended enquiry form.

quizzes.question: What trigger starts the follow-up workflow?
quizzes.explanation: The workflow starts with the Form Submitted trigger, filtered to only the intended enquiry form. This ensures the right form submissions begin the follow-up sequence.

quizzes.question: Why should you filter the Form Submitted trigger by a specific form?

options.option_text: To make the workflow run faster
So unrelated forms do not trigger the sales sequence
To reduce the number of workflow executions

quizzes.explanation: Without filtering by form, any form submission — including customer service forms or feedback surveys — could trigger your sales follow-up sequence. The filter ensures only the intended enquiry form starts the workflow.

quizzes.question: When should you publish the workflow?

options.option_text: After adding the first email action
When the client asks for it

quizzes.explanation: Keep the workflow unpublished until you have tested it thoroughly. Publishing before testing risks sending incorrect or incomplete follow-ups to real prospects.
